title: Why Hitting Your Funny Bone Hurts

sections.name: Why Hitting Your Funny Bone Hurts
lines: Hit your funny bone, and it's anything but funny.
That's because it's not a bone at all. It's a nerve, called the ulnar nerve.
It runs from your neck, all the way down to your little finger.
At your elbow, it passes through a groove, with almost no padding.
So a knock squashes it against the bone, and it fires all at once.
That's why the tingle shoots down into your ring and little fingers.
And the name? It might be a pun. The bone above it is called the humerus.
